name: VATHEN Structured Knowledge System Agent Index
source_scope: 59 related Notion pages discovered within the 先知资料库 hierarchy and linked VATHEN/DAC materials, plus 51 rows from the two linked development task databases.
sync_note: Versioned static snapshot: 59 related Notion pages and 51 rows from two linked task databases. This is curated into a structured architecture but is not live-synchronized with Notion.
reading_protocol: Load data/knowledge-architecture.json before retrieving page content.
Choose the relevant section and follow its reading sequence.
Read role=core documents first; use role=related for supporting detail; role=task for execution state; role=archive for historical traceability.
Prefer the latest confirmed or execution-baseline document when versions conflict; if status is proposed or pending review, do not treat it as approved.
Preserve the Notion source URL and document ID when citing. Never infer approval from recency alone.

categories.name: 决策、路线图与变更记录

database_sources.name: VATHEN DAC 开发任务看板

organization_principles: The architecture is the primary navigation and retrieval taxonomy; raw Notion page order is not authoritative.

Read strategy before product decisions; editorial method before content production; canonical data model before source ingestion; architecture and ADR before implementation; permission model before agent automation.
Prefer core documents over related references; preserve status, version, source URL, and evidence.
Proposals, pending validation, and historical records must not be represented as approved decisions.
Task database rows are execution records, not canonical policy documents.

retrieval_rules.strategy: Strategic direction, mission, target audience, competitive positioning and business assumptions.
retrieval_rules.brand: Brand narrative, identity, visual standards and design assets.
retrieval_rules.business: Paid audience, value proposition, membership, pricing and growth economics.
retrieval_rules.product: Product portfolio, website blueprint, PRDs, user journeys and MVP scope.
retrieval_rules.research: Research methods, evidence standards, editorial voice, writing pipeline and quality gates.
retrieval_rules.data: DAC, sources, entity intelligence, canonical data models, evidence and dashboards.
retrieval_rules.engineering: Architecture decisions, delivery plans, implementation standards, CI/CD and project tasks.
retrieval_rules.agents: Agent roles, prompts, knowledge binding, tool permissions, autonomy and evaluation.
retrieval_rules.governance: Versioning, source-of-truth, audits, missing materials, decision records and roadmap.
retrieval_rules.archive: Original Notion pages, historical snapshots and traceability-only records.
